_comment: Arbitrum One (42161) currencies to wire into ChainlinkPriceOracle via SetOracleFeeds.s.sol. Parallel arrays; `symbol` keys into script/oracle_feeds.json, `decimals` is the token's own ERC-20 decimals (18 for native ETH = address(0)). Token addresses match script/price_pools/42161.json. WBTC uses the WBTC/USD feed (tracks the wrapper, heartbeat 86400) rather than BTC/USD (heartbeat 1755) — switch the symbol to "BTC" if you prefer the tighter heartbeat over wrapper-aware pricing.
